Retrieves scan evidence details for a finding based on the specified ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/easm/easm-ui/v1/organizations/:orgId/findings/:findingId/evidence

Retrieves scan evidence details for a finding based on the specified ID. This is a subset of the scan output obtained for the associated asset that can be attributed to the finding. To learn more, see Understanding Finding Details.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
orgId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

findingId
string
REQUIRED

Identifier extracted from the path. Renamed automatically; review the description and tighten the schema if needed.

HEADER PARAMETERS
Authorization
string
REQUIRED

API authentication token

Default value: Bearer your-token
Responses
​
200
401
500

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
content
string

The scan output information

source_type
string

The scanning service used to detect the risk, such as Web, Network, Certificate, or DNS scans.
